system.description:
Allows the character or item to move quickly on the ground using various movement techniques.

  • Level 1: Ground speed up to 10 kph
  • Level 2: Ground speed up to 25 kph
  • Level 3: Ground speed up to 50 kph
  • Level 4: Ground speed up to 100 kph
  • Level 5: Ground speed up to 250 kph
  • Level 6: Ground speed up to 500 kph
